chunks: Zurarah narrated from Abī Jaʿfar عليه السلام that he said:
When the salat has been established, speaking becomes forbidden for the Imam and the people of the mosque, except regarding the appointment of an Imam.

key_terms.أُقِيمَتِ: was established or commenced, referring here to the iqamah for salat
key_terms.إِمَامٍ: an Imam, here meaning the one to lead the congregational prayer
key_terms.الصَّلَاةُ: the salat (prayer), specifically the congregational prayer about to begin
key_terms.الْمَسْجِدِ: the mosque, meaning those present there for prayer

ai.seo_question: Is speaking allowed after the iqamah has been established for congregational salat?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling on conduct after the iqamah for congregational salat has been established. It indicates that speech is prohibited for the Imam and those present in the mosque at that point, except for speech needed to put forward an Imam.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.1137 – Zurarah narrated from Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir (as) that He said:
"When the prayer has been established (by the iqamah), speaking becomes forbidden for the Imam and the people of the mosque, except in the matter of appointing an Imam”.
